errors.text_span: The horizontal axis, labeled “Size (B),” represents the model size in billions of parameters, ordered from smallest (3B) to largest (7B), and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 95.
errors.evidence: The figure does not have an axis labeled “Size (B)”; it is organized into subplots (a)-(f) with x-axis category labels like 3B, unk, 405B, 1.5B, 671B, and 7B, not a single horizontal size axis. The stated 0 to 95 range is also incorrect for the x-axis.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” represents the performance score, with a scale ranging from 0 to 100, and is marked with integer tick labels.
errors.evidence: The value axis is on the vertical direction, but it is not labeled “Score” in the figure. Also, the range is not always 0 to 100: the left MATH-500 panels use 65–100, while the AIME24 panels use 0–90.

errors.text_span: The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model is represented by a blue bar with a score of approximately 95 on both MATH-500 and AIME24
errors.evidence: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct is blue, but its values are about 78.2 on MATH-500 and 30.0 on AIME24, not 95 on both.

errors.text_span: the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct model is depicted by a red bar with a score of approximately 97.3 on MATH-500 and 95.2 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: The model/color mapping is wrong: Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct is green in the legend, not red. The values 97.3 and 95.2 correspond to other bars in the figure, not this model.

errors.text_span: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B model is shown by a purple bar, achieving a score of 90.8 on MATH-500 and 95 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B is shown with red hatched bars, not purple. Its values are 91.6 on MATH-500 and 63.3 on AIME24, not 90.8 and 95.

errors.text_span: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model is represented by a green bar, attaining a score of 79.8 on MATH-500 and 83.3 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B is orange hatched, not green. The values 79.8 and 83.3 correspond to the 7B bars in the figure, but the color mapping is incorrect.

errors.text_span: The o1-mini model is represented by a teal bar with a score of 74.6 on MATH-500 and 71.4 on AIME24
errors.evidence: o1-mini is pink, not teal. Its values are 90.0 on MATH-500 and 63.6 on AIME24, not 74.6 and 71.4.

errors.text_span: the o1-preview model is depicted as a golden bar, scoring 63.6 on MATH-500 and 66.3 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: o1-preview is brown, not golden. The values are 85.5 on MATH-500 and 44.6 on AIME24, not 63.6 and 66.3.

errors.text_span: The o1 model is shown as a sky blue bar with a score of 79.2 on MATH-500 and 80 on AIME24
errors.evidence: o1 is gray, not sky blue. Its values are 94.8 on MATH-500 and 79.2 on AIME24, not 79.2 and 80.

errors.text_span: the DeepSeek-R1 model is depicted as a coral bar with a score of 44.6 on AIME24 and 83.3 on MATH-500.
errors.evidence: DeepSeek-R1 is beige/yellow, not coral. The values 83.3 and 44.6 belong to different bars and are reversed for the two benchmarks.
The description does not mention the grouped panel structure into six subplots labeled (a) through (f), nor the legend/hatched styling that distinguishes CoT vs TTS and the different model families.
